title: Hota Rahega Shaam o Saher Aoun o Mohd ka Matam
body:
Hota rahega Shaam o saher aoun o mohd ka matam tukde karega qalb o jigar aoun o mohd ka matam
1 Ran se jab aaye laashe pisar sajdaye haq mein thi madar
Karna saki woh ji bhar kar aoun o mohd ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zikr jab aaye Zainab ka girya karenge ahle aza hashr talak hoga ghar ghar aoun o mohd ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ran se khaimaiye Zainab par chak gariba khak basar karte hove aaye Sarwar aoun o mohd ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Lete raho zehra ki dua zikre shahdeen karke buka karte raho be quaf o qatar aoun o mohd ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dete rahenge ahle aza saniye zehra ko pursa hoke karenge khoon mein tar aoun o mohd ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hashr mein uski baqshish ka dekh yahi saman hoga dil se karenga ga jo mazher aoun o mohd ka matam
